clues.title: Coverage: Vientiane
text: All other Laos coverage was taken with unique google car but if you have a vibe you are in Thailand but you will see yellow plates, ppl are driving on the right etc you will be in capital of Laos - Vientiane.

clues.title: Architecture: Unique car
text: If you are in South East Asia with this roof-rack car you gonna be in one of 4 cities in Laos: Vang Vieng, Luang Prabang, Savannakhet, and Pakse.
Note: You can find similar car in Guatemala so look around before making a guess.

clues.title: Google car: Unique Car
text: In all cities except for the capital, Vientiane, this Google car will be visible.
It is silver-coloured, with a roof rack with two metal bars and black side mirrors.
A similar car can be found in Guatemala, so be sure to look at the other clues before guessing.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Plate: License Plates
text: Laotian licence plates are short and yellow.
This distinguishes them from nearby Thailand and Cambodia, who both use white plates on non-commercial vehicles.
Laotian commercial plates are white, and government plates are blue.
Thailand uses yellow plates for commercial vehicles, such as taxis.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Architecture: Historical Architecture
text: Luang Prabang is the former royal capital of Laos and a UNESCO heritage site.
The city has a lot of historical architecture, including several temples.
Many buildings make use of traditional dark wooden architectural elements.
